name: install-activate-cwm-sol
description: Activate images to a device. The input and output has been updated to follow the input and output schema. The output schema is given in metadata. Failure: If the device is a Cisco device then the EMS activity executor is called, otherwise NSO activity executor is called. If the EMS/NSO adapter return failure status then the workflow would return failure.

definition.name: install-activate-cwm-sol

dataConditions.name: install-EMS
dataConditions.condition: ${(."app-data".device.vendor | ascii_downcase == "cisco systems")}

dataConditions.name: install-NSO
dataConditions.condition: ${(."app-data".device.vendor | ascii_downcase == "juniper networks")}

dataConditions.name: check-iosxr
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".data.useEMSResource == false) }

dataConditions.name: check-iosxr
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco 8000 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540L Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5700 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 9000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco XRv 9000 Series Virtual Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5500 Series") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540 Series Routers") }

dataConditions.name: check-iosxe
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 920 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 900 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 1000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 series switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8300 Series Edge Platforms") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8000V Edge Chassis Platforms") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 3650 Series Switches") }

dataConditions.name: check-iosxr
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco 8000 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540L Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5700 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 9000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco XRv 9000 Series Virtual Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5500 Series") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540 Series Routers") }

dataConditions.name: check-iosxe
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 900 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 1000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 series switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8300 Series Edge Platforms") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8000V Edge Chassis Platforms") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 3650 Series Switches") }

stateDataFilter.output: ${ .activity.type="activate" | .activity.input."image-files"=."app-data".data.softwareImages | .deviceIp=."app-data".device.ip | .emsResourceId="EMS" | .activity.input.location=(if (.activate.location and .activate.location != "") then .activate.location else "harddisk:" end) | .activity.input.fpd=(if .activate.fpd == true then "true" else "false" end) | .activity.input.isISSUUpgrade=(if .activate.isISSUUpgrade == true then "true" else "false" end) }

${ .activity.type="activate" | .activity.input."image-files"=."app-data".data.softwareImages | .deviceIp=."app-data".device.ip | .emsResourceId="EMS" | .activity.input.location=(if (.distribute.location and .distribute.location != "") then .distribute.location else (if ((."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 3650 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 series switches")) then "flash" else "bootflash" end) end) | .activity.input.fpd=(if .activate.fpd == true then "true" else "false" end) | .activity.input.isISSUUpgrade=(if .activate.isISSUUpgrade == true then "true" else "false" end) }

${ .activity.type="activate" | .device=."app-data".device.name | .activity.input."image-files"=."app-data".data.softwareImages | .resourceId=."app-data"."resource" | .activity.input.repository=(if .activate.configuredRepo then .activate.configuredRepo else (if .activate.location then .activate.location else (if ."app-data".image.repository then ."app-data".image.repository else (if (."app-data".device.vendor | ascii_downcase == "cisco systems") then "harddisk:" else "/var/tmp" end) end) end) end) }

${ .activity.type="activate" | .device=."app-data".device.name | .activity.input."image-files"=."app-data".data.softwareImages | .resourceId=."app-data"."resource" | .activity.input.repository=(if .activate.configuredRepo then .activate.configuredRepo else (if (.activate.location and .activate.location != "") then .activate.location else (if ((."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 3650 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 series switches")) then "flash" else "bootflash" end) end) end) }

logs.message: Calling emsactivityexecutor to do activate operation
Calling actionexecutor to do activate operation

dataConditions.condition: ${(.activityOutput.jobDetails and (.activityOutput.jobDetails.jobResult | ascii_downcase == "success")) or (.activityOutput.status and (.activityOutput.status | ascii_downcase == "success"))}

stateDataFilter.output: ${ if .device == null then (if ."app-data".device.name then (.device.deviceName = ."app-data".device.name) end) else (. | del(.device) | (.device.deviceName = ."app-data".device.name)) end }

dataConditions.condition: ${(.activityOutput.data."tailf-ncs:output".result != "failed") and (.activityOutput.data."tailf-ncs:output".fingerprint[0].value | type == "string") and (.activityOutput.data."tailf-ncs:output".fingerprint[0].value != "")}
${ .counterSsh < 3 }

stateDataFilter.output: ${ .counterSsh = .counterSsh + 1 }

dataConditions.name: check-iosxr
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco 8000 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540L Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5700 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 9000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco XRv 9000 Series Virtual Routers")or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5500 Series") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540 Series Routers") }
${.deviceSyncFrom.status == "success"}
${ .counter < 3 }

stateDataFilter.output: ${ .counter = .counter + 1 }
${{"status": "success", "message": ("Activation of " + (."app-data".data.softwareImages | join(",")) + " is successful. SSH key has been fetched successfully.")}}
${{"status": "success", "message": ("Activation of " + (."app-data".data.softwareImages | join(",")) + " is successful. SSH key has been fetched successfully. Device has been synced successfully.")}}

logs.message: Activation of ${(."app-data".data.softwareImages | join(",")) is successful, but fetching host key failed.

stateDataFilter.output: ${{"status": "failed", "message": (if (.activityOutput.errors != null and .activityOutput.errors != []) then .activityOutput.errors else "Activation of " + (."app-data".data.softwareImages | join(",")) + " is successful, but fetching ssh host key failed." end)}}

logs.message: Activation of ${(."app-data".data.softwareImages | join(",")) is successful, but device sync failed.

stateDataFilter.output: ${{"status": "failed", "message": (if (.activityOutput.errors != null and .activityOutput.errors != []) then .activityOutput.errors else "Activation of " + (."app-data".data.softwareImages | join(",")) + " is successful, ssh host key has been fetched successfully, but device sync failed." end)}}

dataConditions.name: check-lintd
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco 8000 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540L Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5700 Series Routers") }

dataConditions.name: check-lintd
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5500 Series") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 9000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco XRv 9000 Series Virtual Routers")}

dataConditions.name: check-xe-ASR
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 920 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 900 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 1000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8000V Edge Chassis Platforms") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8300 Series Edge Platforms") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 series switches") }

dataConditions.name: check-xe-Cat
dataConditions.condition: ${(."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 3650 Series Switches") }

dataConditions.name: check-Juniper
dataConditions.condition: ${(."app-data".device.productSeries == "Juniper Networks Inc MX Series") }

stateDataFilter.output: ${ .errorCommand = "show install log last 3" }
${ .errorCommand = "show install log detail | utility tail count 50" }
${ .errorCommand = "show install log" }
${ .errorCommand = "show bootlog switch active R0" }

dataConditions.name: output is valid
dataConditions.condition: ${ if .rakutilExecutorData.status=="success" then true else false end}

stateDataFilter.output:
${{"status": "failed", "message": (if .activityOutput.jobDetails.message != null then .activityOutput.jobDetails.message else (if .activityOutput.message != null then .activityOutput.message else "Activate failed" end) end), stash: (.rakutilExecutorData.stash.output."file-content" | split("output") as $jun_log | $jun_log[-5] + " " + $jun_log[-4] + " " + $jun_log[-3] + " " + $jun_log[-2] | split("
") as $split_val | $split_val | map(select((contains(">") or (contains("<"))) | not)))}}

logs.message: Calling nsoactivityexecutor to run the required command

dataConditions.name: output is valid
dataConditions.condition: ${ if .activityOutput.status=="success" then true else false end}

stateDataFilter.output: ${{"status": "failed", "message": (if .activityOutput.jobDetails.message != null then .activityOutput.jobDetails.message else (if .activityOutput.message != null then .activityOutput.message else "Activate failed" end) end), stash: (if (."app-data".device."softwareType" == "IOS XE") then [.activityOutput.output."tailf-ned-cisco-ios-stats:output".result] else [.activityOutput.output."tailf-ned-cisco-ios-xr-stats:output".result] end)}}

${{"status": "failed", "message": (if .activityOutput.jobDetails.message != null then .activityOutput.jobDetails.message else (if .activityOutput.message != null then .activityOutput.message else "Activate failed" end) end)}}

logs.message: Selected product series is not supported

stateDataFilter.output: ${{status:"failed", message: "Selected product series is not supported." }}

logs.message: Error while executing activate activity on resource

stateDataFilter.output: ${{"status": "failed", "message": (if .activityOutput.jobDetails.message != null then .activityOutput.jobDetails.message else (if .activityOutput.message != null then .activityOutput.message else "Error while executing activity on resource." end) end)}}
